crew.overview: Oakland, California. Young Afro-American Oscar Grant crosses paths with family members, friends, enemies and strangers before facing his fate on the platform at Fruitvale Station, in the early morning hours of New Year's Day 2009.
crew.title: Fruitvale Station

details.biography: Lowell A. Meyer (born February 27, 1989) is an American cinematographer. He studied cinematography and photography at Emerson College in Boston, Massachusetts, and now lives and works as a freelance cameraman in Los Angeles, California. He is an associate member of the Society of Camera Operators and has been recognized for his work as a cinematographer by the Minneapolis Underground Film Festival.
details.name: Lowell A. Meyer
details.place_of_birth: New York City, New York, USA
